audience: Norwegian businesses that run invoicing and bookkeeping in Conta

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List the organizations to get the organization id. Read the three latest unpaid invoices and the unpaid and overdue sums.

useCases.title: Check the profit and loss
useCases.text: Get the profit and loss report for a period, or the trial balance for an account range.

useCases.title: See open receivables per customer
useCases.text: Get the open receivables for one customer or for all customers, as of a date.

useCases.title: Create a customer
useCases.text: Create a customer with its name, customer type code, and street, postcode and city. This writes live accounting data.
